main_result: Source split conformal prediction under-covered under deployment shifts but not under exchangeable random controls.
best_supported_conclusion: Small target-domain calibration sets restore conformal coverage under public health deployment shifts in public datasets; source-only weighting is not an adequate substitute.
publication_readiness_note: The study can support a benchmark/methods manuscript but still needs real ICU/EHR validation for a high-impact clinical deployment claim.
